people.name: Mark Paul Stein
people.title_or_status: MP STEIN, LLC MEMBER AND MANAGER
people.bio_note: Principal at Galvin, Gaustad & Stein (CLU, CFP). Longtime Chartered Life Underwriter and CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER professional with over 30 years in the financial industry (career start 1985 per industry records). Prior to co-founding the firm, was President of AeGIS Financial Group, Inc. for 18 years. A nationally recognized public speaker for accounting and consumer groups, serves on the Arizona Family College Savings Program Oversight Committee (Arizona's 529 Plan), and is a past President of the Greater Phoenix Financial Planning Association.
people.bio_source: Firm website (ggsadvisors.com) corroborated by Beverly Hills Chamber of Commerce member profile (members.beverlyhillschamber.com/list/member/galvin-gaustad-stein-llc-wealth-management-mark-p-stein-cfp-clu-principal-54943), which details his AeGIS Financial Group presidency and industry leadership roles
